instruction: Speak in French. Begin at a moderate speaking rate, then continuously accelerate your pace throughout the sentence.
text: Pour comprendre l'histoire de l'art moderne, il faut d'abord examiner les mouvements artistiques du dix-neuvième siècle qui ont ouvert la voie à de nouvelles formes d'expression.

target_values.speed: start at a normal pace and gradually accelerate to a fast speed

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio completely fails to follow the instruction. Instead of continuously accelerating, the speaker's pace slows down significantly towards the end of the sentence.

instruction_evidence.speed_progression: The speaker starts at a moderate pace but slows down, with the final phrase 'à de nouvelles formes d'expression' being spoken very slowly, which is the exact opposite of the requested acceleration.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not applicable due to low instruction-following score.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not applicable due to low instruction-following score.

instruction: Speak in French. Perform this monologue by starting softly and increasing your volume throughout, ending in a powerful, loud voice.
text: Au début, ce n'était qu'un murmure dans le vent, une idée fragile, mais maintenant c'est un cri, une tempête, une force que rien ne pourra arrêter !

target_values.volume: begin by speaking quietly, then build up to a very loud volume by the end

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The required dynamic progression is largely absent. The speaker starts at a normal volume rather than softly, and there is no clear, gradual increase to a powerful, loud voice at the end.

instruction_evidence.start_softly: The beginning of the monologue is spoken at a normal, moderate volume, lacking the requested soft delivery.
instruction_evidence.increase_volume_throughout: The volume remains relatively flat throughout the audio with no distinct crescendo.
instruction_evidence.end_loudly: The ending has slightly more emphasis but is not noticeably louder or more powerful than the beginning.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not evaluated as instruction following is below 3.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not evaluated as instruction following is below 3.

instruction: Speak in French. Read this list starting at your normal pitch, let your pitch rise high in the middle, and then bring it back down to normal for the end.
text: Pour ce projet, nous aurons besoin de plusieurs choses : du papier, des ciseaux, de la colle forte, des marqueurs de toutes les couleurs, et enfin, un peu de patience.

target_values.pitch: start with a normal pitch, raise it to high in the middle, and then return to a normal pitch at the end

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The pitch progression is clearly realized, starting normal, rising significantly in the middle of the list, and returning to normal at the end.

instruction_evidence.pitch_progression: The voice starts at a baseline pitch, noticeably increases pitch during 'des ciseaux, de la colle forte', and drops back to the baseline for 'et enfin, un peu de patience'.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The pitch shift in the middle sounds a bit artificial and strained.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The dynamic pitch variation is executed clearly and adds a lively expressive contour to the list.

instruction: Speak in French. Read this sentence in a calm, neutral tone, but then react with sudden surprise on the last few words.
text: Je regardais par la fenêtre, observant les gens passer comme d'habitude, quand j'ai vu un éléphant sur un skateboard.

target_values.emotion: start with a neutral emotion, but sound suddenly surprised towards the end

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The sudden surprise towards the end of the sentence is completely absent. Instead, the delivery becomes flat, slow, and robotic on the final words.

instruction_evidence.calm_neutral_start: The first part of the sentence is read in a calm and somewhat neutral tone.
instruction_evidence.sudden_surprise_ending: There is no surprise at all on 'quand j'ai vu un éléphant sur un skateboard'; the tone actually drops in energy and becomes noticeably artificial.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not applicable since instruction following level is not 3. The audio has significant robotic artifacts at the end.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not applicable. Expressiveness fails to capture the intended dynamic change.

instruction: Speak in French. Perform this line by transitioning from a questioning, uncertain tone to a resolute and confident one.
text: Peut-être que nous devrions attendre... ou peut-être pas. Non, j'en suis certain. C'est le moment de prendre ce risque et d'avancer.

target_values.tone: begin with a hesitant tone, but become more firm and confident as you speak

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio fails to convey the requested dynamic transition. The delivery is consistently flat and robotic, lacking both the initial uncertainty and the subsequent confidence.

instruction_evidence.questioning_uncertain_tone: The beginning does not sound questioning or uncertain, it merely features pauses with a flat inflection.
instruction_evidence.resolute_confident_tone: The latter half of the sentence does not sound resolute or confident; it continues with the same monotonous, synthetic delivery.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds highly synthetic, disjointed, and robotic.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery lacks expressiveness and emotional variation completely.

instruction: Speak in French. As you read this, simultaneously increase your speed from slow to fast and your volume from soft to very loud.
text: La voiture approchait lentement du virage, puis elle a accéléré, de plus en plus vite, jusqu'à franchir la ligne d'arrivée en tête sous les acclamations de la foule !

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio has a largely flat delivery. The requested simultaneous increase in speed and volume is missing; the speed increases only very slightly and the volume remains completely constant.

instruction_evidence.speed: There is only a minimal, barely noticeable increase in speed towards the end, failing to achieve the requested 'slow to fast' progression.
instruction_evidence.volume: The volume remains constant throughout the entire clip, failing entirely to go from soft to very loud.

instruction: Speak in French. At a constant slow speed, begin speaking as if you are lost in thought, and then let a warm, happy feeling enter your voice as you continue.
text: On se demande parfois si on a fait les bons choix dans la vie... et puis on regarde ses enfants jouer et on sait que chaque moment en valait la peine.

target_values.speed: maintain a constant slow speed throughout

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The speaker successfully maintains a constant, slow speed, but the emotional transition is weak. The delivery remains relatively flat throughout, failing to introduce a clear 'warm, happy feeling' in the second half.

instruction_evidence.speed: The audio maintains a constant and slow pace from beginning to end.
instruction_evidence.emotional_transition: The initial tone could pass as thoughtful due to the slow pacing, but the requested shift to a warm and happy emotion is largely absent, resulting in a flattened execution.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds highly synthetic, robotic, and lacks smooth, human-like phrasing.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is monotonous, completely missing the expressive variation required to convey the intended emotional progression.

instruction: Speak in French. Deliver this line with two opposing dynamic changes: your pitch should go up, and your volume should go down.
text: C'était comme un cri puissant qui s'est transformé en un murmure strident, s'étirant vers le silence tout en devenant plus perçant.

target_values.pitch: gradually rise from low to high
target_values.volume: simultaneously fade from loud to quiet

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio successfully implements the requested volume decrease, fading from loud to quiet, but fails to simultaneously raise the pitch. The pitch remains relatively flat or decreases slightly, missing the opposing dynamic change.

instruction_evidence.pitch: The pitch does not noticeably rise from low to high; it remains relatively stable or drops slightly towards the end.
instruction_evidence.volume: The volume clearly fades from a loud beginning to a quiet, almost whispered ending.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not evaluated due to instruction-following level < 3.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not evaluated due to instruction-following level < 3.

instruction: Speak in French. Your performance should move from thoughtful (slow, normal pitch) to worried (faster, higher pitch), and finally to fearful (very fast, high pitch).
text: Je ne retrouve plus mon portefeuille, je l'avais il y a une minute... J'espère vraiment que je ne l'ai pas perdu dans la rue... Mon Dieu, mon passeport était dedans !

target_values.progression: Start thoughtful (slow, normal pitch), then become worried (faster, higher pitch), and end fearful (very fast, high pitch).

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The required progression is completely absent. The entire audio is delivered in an extremely fast, high-pitched, and hysterical tone from the very beginning, failing to start thoughtfully or show any dynamic emotional shift.

instruction_evidence.thoughtful_start: The beginning is not slow or at a normal pitch; it is extremely high-pitched, loud, and fast.
instruction_evidence.worried_middle: There is no transition to a worried state, as the voice is already at maximum intensity.
instruction_evidence.fearful_end: The end remains at the same high-pitched, frantic level as the rest of the audio, showing no progression.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not applicable due to instruction-following level 1.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not applicable due to instruction-following level 1.

instruction: Speak in French. Perform a transition of tone: from uncaring to pleading, and then from pleading to resigned disappointment.
text: Vous pouvez choisir n'importe laquelle des options, ça ne change rien. Mais ne voyez-vous pas que celle-ci est la seule qui peut nous sauver ? D'accord, alors. Il n'y a plus rien à dire.

target_values.tone: begin with an indifferent tone, then shift to a pleading one, and finish with a disappointed tone

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The dynamic emotional progression is completely absent. The voice is highly robotic and monotonous throughout, failing to convey uncaring, pleading, or resigned tones.

instruction_evidence.uncaring: The initial delivery is flat due to synthetic generation, not intentional indifference.
instruction_evidence.pleading: There is no audible shift to a pleading tone; the voice remains emotionally flat.
instruction_evidence.resigned disappointment: The final segment lacks any expression of disappointment or resignation.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech is very synthetic, robotic, and unnatural.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is entirely flat and lacks any expressive variation.

instruction: Speak in French. Deliver the first part with a detached, sarcastic tone. Then, let that sarcasm give way to real anger, making your voice firm and direct.
text: Ah, te voilà avec la réponse à tout. Je devrais peut-être prendre des notes pour la prochaine fois. Mais tu sais quoi ? J'en ai marre de ce petit jeu ! Ce n'est pas drôle, et les conséquences sont réelles. Il est temps que tu ouvres les yeux !

target_values.progression: Start with a sarcastic tone while emotionally neutral. Then, transition into genuine anger with a firm tone.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The progression is completely lost due to bizarre pitch fluctuations. The transition to 'firm and direct' genuine anger is contradicted by unnatural, cartoonish high-pitched squeaks.

instruction_evidence.detached_sarcasm: The beginning is somewhat detached, but the sarcasm is weakly delivered.
instruction_evidence.transition_to_firm_anger: Instead of becoming firm and genuinely angry, the voice unpredictably jumps into a bizarrely high-pitched, squeaky tone that sounds comical and synthetic.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: N/A for level 1. The audio contains severe pitch artifacts and unnatural vocal shifts.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: N/A for level 1. The expressive shifts are inappropriate and undermine the intended emotion.
